classification: participant-reported guided manual completion with verified saved outputs
timing_boundary: Browser timer Start click to Finish click, including chat instructions, replies, waiting, application switching, and save/reopen steps.

guidance.report_entry_method: Not observed; no conclusion about typing versus pasting.
guidance.prior_task_familiarity: Participant previously saw task explanations and project results.

verification_scope: Post-run native Google Sheets connector read of Quotes!A1:F4 including formula sources and effective values; separate saved UTF-8 report read.
raw_collector_preservation: Original records retained unchanged; output verification is a separate post-run check.
report_export_normalization: UTF-8 with LF line endings; wording unchanged.
limitations: Guided practice, not an unassisted completion-time baseline; no agent-versus-human speed ratio is justified.
No task keystroke, mouse, pause-distribution, application-resource or process-event data was collected.
One participant and one guided attempt do not characterize a human population.
Post-run checks establish saved-output correctness, not the exact sequence of actions or authorship.
privacy: Pseudonym only; exact clock times, private paths, spreadsheet identity, timer URL, process IDs and raw resource snapshots omitted.
